column3: what it means   (read by site.sh m1 trace; every reason here must exist in the code: test_site.sh checks)
the request is not exactly the JSON the cell expects (duplicate key, unknown field, trailing content)
the subject is not an enrolled agent
a quota was asked for by an agent that has no quota policy
the quota asked for is above the agent's ceiling
the certificate presented is not the one registered for this agent
this agent is bound to a certificate and may only come over the network
no skill matches this action
the action is known but the resource is outside its declared scope
the cell could not understand the intent
the cell has no valid epoch to sign under
an action of class I or W needs a plan approved by operators, and none was given
the plan binding does not verify
no such plan is submitted
the plan is submitted but not yet approved by enough operators
the plan's approval has expired
the plan was revoked
the request is not a step of the approved plan
the plan was sealed for another agent
the plan store failed (a system fault, alarmed)
an action of class W needs the controllers' proof, and none was given
the controllers' proof does not reach the quorum
the action is outside the agent's envelope
an envelope check was needed and cannot be made
the signed rules do not allow this action
the signed rules gave no answer: refused
the policy engine took too long: refused
the policy engine could not be reached: refused
the policy engine shed this request under load
the policy engine is stalled: refused
the decision was allow but the token could not be signed
allowed
this token was already used once
the token was issued for another action or resource
the token's signature does not verify (altered or forged)
the token is not a well-formed token
the token's content does not follow the schema
the token is signed by a key this server does not know
the token is too old
the token is not valid yet (clocks apart?)
the token's lifetime is outside the allowed range
the token was issued under other rules than the ones in force
the token belongs to another epoch
the object seal does not match
the token is too large
the token's headers are not acceptable
the token's algorithm is not acceptable
the token's version is not supported
the token's quota is used up
the quota was exceeded
the request carried no token
pepd did not let the request through (closed, or refused after a restart)
pepd could not be reached: no verdict, no action
the TLS handshake itself was refused (no or wrong client certificate)
a connection failed during the TLS handshake
nothing answered
the cell answered a request that carried no client certificate
